bias.en: Neutral to bearish · slipped under the 30 and 100-day
bias.zh: 中性偏空 · 跌破 30 日和 100 日均线

read.en: Teradyne slipped 0.9% on Oct 13 to $380.29 after an intraday low of $362.58. It closed just below its 30-day ($382.8) and 100-day ($382.2) averages and under the 5-day ($395.5) and 10-day ($411.8), and remains above the 200-day ($342.5). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 12 and is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($446.7), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月13日下跌 0.9%，收于 $380.29，盘中低点 $362.58。股价收于 30 日（$382.8）和 100 日均线（$382.2）略下方，并低于 5 日（$395.5）和 10 日均线（$411.8），仍在 200 日均线（$342.5）上方。MACD 于 10月12日下穿信号线，仍在零轴上方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$446.7），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The $382 support at the 30 and 100-day averages slipped on the close, though the stock recovered most of an intraday drop to $362.6. That zone is now first resistance, then $395 (5-day average) and $412 (10-day average, Oct 9 high $414). Support is $362.6 (Oct 13 low), then $342 (200-day average) and $326 (September lows). A close back above $383 would repair the break.
read.zh: 30 日和 100 日均线所在的 $382 支撑收盘失守，但股价收复了盘中跌至 $362.6 的大部分跌幅。该区域现为第一阻力，其次 $395（5 日均线）和 $412（10 日均线，10月9日高点 $414）。支撑为 $362.6（10月13日低点），其次 $342（200 日均线）和 $326（9月低点）。若收盘重回 $383 上方，则破位得以修复。
